name: Flinders Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Student Scholarship
summary: Ten awards a year of $6,000 a year for up to four years for commencing First Nations undergraduates with financial need.
key: Each scholarship will be valued at $6,000 per year for up to four years.
who: Be of Australian Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander descent and accepted as such by community
Be in receipt of means-tested government payments or be able to demonstrate financial hardship
Commencing an undergraduate degree, full-time in a Commonwealth Supported Place
how: Apply online through the Flinders University Student System by the closing date
catches: Latest listed round opened 27-07-2026 and closed 19-08-2026
